oddities: gray vs slate mixed: h1 text-gray-900 and subtitle text-gray-600 sit on slate-based bodies; free_elective/other/credentials badges use bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 while plan 'planned' pill uses bg-slate-100 text-slate-600; Card base text-gray-900, CardDescription text-gray-500; PatchNotePreview dropdown mock uses gray-700/gray-400 next to slate-700/slate-400 in the detail mock.

Primary CTA color is not consistent across admin pages: courses/departments bg-[#00AACA] hover:bg-[#153974]; patch-notes bg-[#153974] hover:bg-[#0f2a57]; requirements bg-[#153974] hover:bg-[#1a4a94]. #0f2a57 and #1a4a94 are off-brand hexes (not #153974 / #3069B3 / #00AACA). #3069B3 never appears in admin.
Hover of a teal button turning navy (bg-[#00AACA] -> hover:bg-[#153974]) is a hue swap rather than a shade step; back link does the same (text-[#00AACA] -> hover:text-[#153974]).

Modal backdrop opacity differs: bg-black/50 (courses, departments) vs bg-black/40 (requirements). Only requirements modals close on backdrop click (onClick + stopPropagation) and only requirements adds mx-4 so the max-w-lg panel keeps a phone gutter; courses/departments panels touch the viewport edge on phones.

Five different destructive-confirm patterns: (a) inline swap to [삭제][취소] px-3 py-1.5 (courses); (b) inline swap to [확인][취소] px-2 py-1 (patch-notes, different label and size); (c) dedicated confirm modal (departments h2 '학과 삭제'; requirements h3 '삭제 확인'); (d) native window.confirm (feedback delete; users role change); (e) expanded-footer warning text + [취소][삭제 확인] (users).

Cancel button has four styles: bg-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-300 (courses); ghost hover:bg-slate-100 (departments, feedback); border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 (requirements); bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 (users). Patch-notes inline cancel uses text-slate-500 instead of 600.

Edit icon hover: hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-600 everywhere except patch-notes (hover:bg-blue-50 hover:text-blue-500). Delete icon hover: hover:text-red-600 (courses/departments/requirements) vs hover:text-red-500 (feedback/patch-notes). Icon button padding p-2 vs p-1.5; modal close p-1 (courses) vs p-1.5 (patch-notes).

Badge weight/padding inconsistent: category/status/role/code badges font-semibold px-2.5; version badge font-semibold px-2; credits badge font-medium px-2; studentId/provider/feedback-status badges font-medium px-2.5; patch-note status badge font-semibold while feedback status badge font-medium for the same yellow/green pair.

Search input padding varies per page: pl-9 pr-8 (courses), pl-10 pr-9 (departments), pl-9 pr-9 (requirements), pl-10 pr-3 (users, no clear button). Clear X positioned right-2 (courses) vs right-3 (others). Wrapper width: bare relative (courses) vs flex-1 min-w-[200px] (departments/requirements) vs flex-1 min-w-[200px] max-w-sm (users).

Form label scale differs: text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 (courses/departments/patch-notes) vs text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 (requirements) with sub-labels text-xs text-slate-500. Required marker is * in most forms but a literal ' *' inside label text in requirements.

Requirements inputs omit text-slate-700 (inherit) and its selects omit bg-white, unlike every other page's identical-looking controls; it is also the only form using <fieldset>/<legend> and a disabled:bg-slate-50 disabled:text-slate-400 state.

Textarea styles differ: courses (no bg, text-slate-700, resize-none last), feedback (bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:bg-white), patch-notes (bg-white text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400). Input text color is text-slate-700 on most pages but text-slate-900 on patch-notes.

Modal heading weight: text-lg font-bold (courses/departments/requirements modals) vs text-lg font-semibold (patch-notes inline editor). Requirements delete dialog uses <h3> where departments uses <h2>.
Card base is rounded-lg while every skeleton, error banner and empty state is rounded-2xl: the placeholder shapes do not match the cards they stand in for. Modal panels are rounded-2xl too.

Card base `border` has no color utility; under Tailwind v4 defaults that is currentColor (text-gray-900) unless globals.css restores the v3 compat default — must be verified against the globals reader's notes.
Card base includes hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300, so every non-interactive admin row card lifts on hover; dashboard menu cards then re-add the same classes redundantly.

Stat card accent colors (#153974 / green-600 / purple-600 / orange-600) are decorative and collide with semantic uses elsewhere (green = success/resolved/publish/admin-reply; purple = teaching/studentId/preview; orange = data-error/major_compulsory).

Red is heavily overloaded: admin role badge, bug category, major_required, failed course status, '관리자로 변경' promote button (solid bg-red-600 reads as destructive though it is a promotion), and all true destructive actions.
Green is overloaded: resolved status, published status, completed course, '답변 없이 해결', '바로 발행', '발행', reply submit, and the admin-reply callout (bg-green-50 border-green-200).
Yellow-100/700 is used for both 'pending/draft' states and the Google provider badge (unrelated semantics).
No pagination anywhere in admin; feedback hard-codes limit=100 in the query string, other lists fetch everything.
No <table> element on any admin page: all 'data tables' are stacks of Card rows with flex layouts, so there are no header rows, zebra stripes, or column alignment.

ui/Button.tsx and ui/Input.tsx exist but admin pages use raw <button>/<input> with hand-copied class strings (the select class string is repeated ~15 times verbatim). cursor-pointer is appended manually to every button (Tailwind v4 removed the default).
Three ad-hoc button sizes: primary px-4 py-2 text-sm; inline px-3 py-1.5 text-xs; micro px-2 py-1 text-xs (patch-notes confirm only).

Accessibility: dashboard year <select> has no label; icon-only buttons rely on title= only (no aria-label); search clear X and patch-notes/courses modal close X have no title or aria-label; users info area is a clickable <div> with cursor-pointer but no role/tabIndex/keyboard handler; departments cancel button is disabled={isSaving} with no disabled: style.

Contrast: text-slate-400 (#94a3b8) on white is ~3.0:1 and is used for text-xs meta rows, counters, placeholders and the font-mono course code; text-[10px] status pills are very small; text-slate-300 empty-state icons ~1.6:1 (decorative).

One-off arbitrary values: max-w-[300px] (patch-note title), min-w-[200px], max-h-[90vh], max-h-96, max-h-64, w-32 sm:w-40, text-[10px], bg-purple-50/30, border-2 border-dashed (preview only), gap-x-4 gap-y-1, space-y-0.5, gap-0.5.

Class ordering/aliases inconsistent: w-4 h-4 and flex-shrink-0 in PatchNotePreview vs h-4 w-4 and shrink-0 in pages; 'text-gray-600 mt-1' vs 'mt-1 text-gray-600'; 'bg-green-50 border border-green-200' vs border-first elsewhere.

Copy inconsistencies: placeholders with and without '...' ('과목명 또는 코드 검색' vs '학과명 또는 코드로 검색...'); empty-state '등록된 과목 없음' (noun form) vs '...없습니다.' elsewhere; inline confirm labelled '삭제' (courses) vs '확인' (patch-notes) vs '삭제 확인' (users); requirements empty state keeps mt-4 on its

despite having no icon above it (orphaned spacing).
Toast taxonomy: admin uses only 'success' and 'warning' — API/network errors are surfaced as warnings, never 'error'.
Users page semester term type is 'spring'|'fall' only and renders '{year}년 1/2학기', while courses page defines four semesters including 여름학기/겨울학기.
Users plan course row uses key={c.course?._id || Math.random()} (unstable key); text-slate-800 appears exactly once (course code) while other row titles use slate-900/gray-900.
Feedback page has no search field (two selects only); patch-notes has a single select — filter bars are page-specific, not a shared component.

DEFAULT_CURRICULUM_YEAR (2026) and DEFAULT_REQUIREMENT_YEAR (2025) differ, so the dashboard/courses default to 2026 while requirements defaults to 2025; year options are hard-coded <option value={2025}>/<option value={2026}> on every page.
